name: pacto-username-nft
description: Pacto username NFT and global gas sponsorship
author: Pacto

scripts.deploy:arbitrum: bash -c 'source .env && forge script DeployUsernameSystem --rpc-url arbitrum --account $ARBITRUM_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain arbitrum -vvvvv && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=verify forge script VerifyDeploy --rpc-url arbitrum --chain arbitrum -vvvv'
scripts.deploy:mainnet: bash -c 'source .env && forge script DeployUsernameSystem --rpc-url mainnet --account $MAINNET_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain mainnet -vvvvv && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=verify forge script VerifyDeploy --rpc-url mainnet --chain mainnet -vvvv'
scripts.deploy:sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && forge script DeployUsernameSystem --rpc-url sepolia --account $SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain sepolia -vvvvv && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=verify forge script VerifyDeploy --rpc-url sepolia --chain sepolia -vvvv'
scripts.deploy:nft:sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && forge script DeployUsernameNft --rpc-url sepolia --account $SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain sepolia -vvvvv'
scripts.update:registry:sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && forge script UpdateProtocolRegistry --rpc-url sepolia --account $SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain sepolia -vvvvv'
scripts.fund:paymaster:sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && forge script FundPaymasterOps --rpc-url sepolia --account $SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain sepolia -vvvvv'
scripts.simulate-deploy:sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && forge script DeployUsernameSystem --rpc-url sepolia --account $SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --chain sepolia -vvvvv'
scripts.simulate-fund:paymaster:sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && forge script FundPaymasterOps --rpc-url sepolia --account $SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --chain sepolia -vvvvv'
scripts.verify:arbitrum: bash -c 'source .env && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=verify forge script VerifyDeploy --rpc-url arbitrum --chain arbitrum -vvvv'
scripts.verify:mainnet: bash -c 'source .env && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=verify forge script VerifyDeploy --rpc-url mainnet --chain mainnet -vvvv'
scripts.verify:sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=verify forge script VerifyDeploy --rpc-url sepolia --chain sepolia -vvvv'
